__baseline_prompt__.text: A medical-horror photograph built around a moment of biomedical unease. Portray a fictional person using the supplied reference image, preserving facial proportions and the short dark bob with wispy fringe. She appears as a laboratory researcher at a stainless-steel counter in a small cryobank room after midnight. An open freezer behind her reveals orderly racks coated in white frost. She has slid one metal vial rack onto the counter and stopped. Every neighboring ampoule is clouded with ice, but a single transparent ampoule in the front row contains thawed amber liquid and a pale folded tissue culture; clear droplets gather beneath its sealed cap and a fresh wet circle spreads around its base. The dry frosted neighbors make this one warm-looking specimen immediately conspicuous. Her left gloved hand braces the rack's near edge while her right gloved hand hovers just above the anomalous ampoule, fingertips paused before contact. The tray rests fully on the counter; her wrists and forearms lead clearly back to her seated body. Her attention stays on the specimen, brows subtly tightened, lips gently parted as she weighs the unexplained change. An unbuttoned white laboratory coat falls over a charcoal tank, its ordinary softness and the quiet light on her cheek lending a subtle intimate human presence against the cold apparatus. Frame from her waist to above her head with the specimen rack prominent in the lower foreground, her three-quarter face on the left and the open freezer receding on the right. A cool task lamp grazes the vial glass and damp steel, while a dim warm corridor light catches her cheek and the edge of her hair. Moderate depth of field keeps her face, hovering fingers and thawed vial readable together. Real photographic skin, fine flyaway hair, matte frost and condensed water; restrained clinical color, a still, unresolved inspection.
